extracted.name: Chocolate Fudge Cake
extracted.description: Great recipe for Chocolate Fudge Cake.
ingredient_lines: 1 Cup Sour Cream (I used maziwa Mala)
instruction_lines: Preheat the oven. In a bowl mix butter and the sugars using low hand mixer. Once creamy add Vanilla and the eggs.

In a separate bowl shift the flour, cocoa, baking soda and baking powder. Add the dry ingredients to the wet ingredients and mix with a mixer. Add the coffee water Add the sour cream and the chopped chocolate.
Bake for 30 to 40 minutes at 175 degrees.
